elaine: Posted the postmortem for the authz outage: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2401234567. Need short owned follow-ups (owner + ETA + 1-line verification). Focus: token validation edge-cases, permission rollbacks, audit reingest, secrets rotation automation.

omar: I'll take token validation fixes (race on refresh + TTL mismatch). ETA: 2026-04-05. Smoke: `pytest tests/unit/test_token_refresh.py::test_race -q`

lucy: I'll handle permission rollbacks and a regression test to prevent broad binds creeping back in. ETA: 2026-04-07. Smoke: `kubectl get clusterrolebinding | grep svc-`

ben: I'll do audit reingest for the 36h gap and add a schema filter to drop malformed entries to DLQ. Backfill ETA: 2026-03-31; validator PR: 2026-04-04. Smoke: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit WHERE protoPayload.methodName="Authenticate" AND timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 36 HOUR)`

ops-bot: Created ticket SEC-1255: "AuthZ postmortem follow-ups". Claimed items: token-fix (omar), perms-rollback (lucy), audit-reingest (ben). Added weekly drift scan (cron: 0 8 * * 1). Link: https://tracker.redwood/SEC-1255

elaine: Posted consolidated tracker in ticket. Please update SEC-1255 when you push PRs or finish backfill. We'll review status in next security sync; escalate in #eng-oncall if blocked. :thumbsup:
